# tundra-node

Privacy tools, homelab projects, cybersecurity notes, and open source software.

## About

Personal site of tundra-node (Elias Zeiner). Cybersecurity student, Boy Scout, FBLA competitor, homelab operator. Privacy first, FOSS oriented, "create over consume."

- [Home](https://tundra-node.github.io/)

## Key projects

- [I2P Easy Manager](https://tundra-node.github.io/projects/i2p-easy-manager/) - simplified I2P setup
- [Nix Config](https://tundra-node.github.io/projects/nix-config/) - NixOS and home-manager config
- [CueKeeper](https://tundra-node.github.io/projects/cuekeeper/) - theater sound cue manager
- [FBLA Cybersecurity Study App](https://tundra-node.github.io/fbla-cybersecurity-2026/) - study tool for FBLA Cyber
- [Chronicle](https://tundra-node.github.io/projects/chronicle/) - life tracking desktop app
- [Nexus](https://tundra-node.github.io/projects/nexus/) - I2P search and router dashboard
